digest.component_or_area: graph link composition and library facade
propositions: When add_dependency escalates a cross-subtree link, the redirect record is emitted only to stdout and never returned, leaving library and MCP callers unaware that different endpoints were recorded than requested.
Three intermediate functions in the call chain (_link closure, _python_leaf, rebar.link) call their downstream functions without returning the redirect record, silently discarding the value.
The MCP link_tickets tool always returns the literal string 'ok' regardless of whether escalation occurred, providing no feedback to agents about endpoint substitution.
The stdout channel cannot be unsuppressed without corrupting the MCP-over-stdio protocol, so the redirect record must travel as a return value through the call chain instead.

The redirect record must be returned by add_dependency and propagated through link_core, the _link closure, _python_leaf, and rebar.link, with link_tickets formatting the substitution in its string return value when escalation occurs.
